title: Copying and Immutability
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of copying and immutability using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates copying and immutability.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Copying and Immutability** as part of **Advanced Properties and Class Modeling**. Apply copying and immutability by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—Shallow Copies and Shared References, Defensive Copying, Designing Immutable Models—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.

content_blocks.title: Common mistake to avoid
content_blocks.text: A data class copy recursively duplicates every object referenced by its properties.

content_blocks.title: Troubleshooting and reset
